callback_review.limit: Pre-replace validation cannot create an atomic transaction with wall-clock time; no artificial wait remains between callback and filesystem replace. This is the stated publication contract, not a claim of hard-real-time kernel commit timing.

tail_helper_scope.conclusion: Helper alone is not a complete data-integrity validator. The tested metadata mutation is rejected by the real outer guard; the isolated costed-tail mutation is not a demonstrated whole-publication economic bypass.
